title: Motives and periods
summary: Are residues of Feynman integrals periods of mixed Tate motives? Three small worked examples answer it for the smallest graphs. 2πi as the period of the Tate motive: drag a loop around the pole of dz/z and watch the Riemann sum converge, with h(P¹) = 𝟏 ⊕ 𝟏(−1) read by point counts as 1 + q. ζ(3) and multiple zeta values: enter a composition to see its iterated-integral word, its dual and both values to double precision, even ζ(2n) as exact rational multiples of (2πi)²ⁿ, and Zagier's dimension counts. Feynman periods of the wheel graphs: Kirchhoff polynomials, C(2n − 2, n − 1)ζ(2n − 3), an independent position-space quadrature of P(K₄) converging to 6ζ(3), and point counts over F_q (q⁵ + q³ − q² for K₄). Every statement is sourced; JSON and Markdown export, a narrated beamdswitch deck, deep links and a self-test on every load. Runs offline.
